strategy.name: XAU_RSI_Mean_Reversion_Loose
strategy.rationale: Looser RSI thresholds (<42/>58) with Bollinger band touch confirmation. Session-filtered. Keeps counter-trend logic but requires band extreme to avoid false entries.

history.analysis: 27% WR, PF 0.78, net -$22.81. Stops dominate (-$94). RSI<33 on XAU almost never fires in current range. Zero trades in 24h = rules too strict. Must loosen entry thresholds and add volume/breakout logic.
mistakes: RSI<33 long trigger on XAU is too extreme - current RSI 46.7 and has rarely dipped that low, causing zero signals for 24h+
27% win rate means entries are wrong directionally more than 2/3 of time - counter-trend pullback logic failing in trending markets
Stop losses hit 94% of loss value while trails captured only $42 profit - stops too tight relative to 5m noise on XAU
Momentum filter op direction on short is wrong (should be < negative value, not < 0.15 which is almost always true)
changes: Drop RSI threshold from <33 to <42 for longs, >58 for shorts - realistic given current RSI 43-47 range across all markets
Add breakout confirmation to avoid pure counter-trend fades - require price breaking recent low/high to confirm momentum
Add session filter for XAU: restrict to 07:00-20:00 UTC (London+NY overlap) where liquidity is highest
Remove ETH entirely - 0.16% round-trip spread is 14x XAU, mathematically requires much larger moves to profit on scalp
Shift from pure pullback to trend-following breakout on 5m - breakout strategies have better win rates in momentum markets

strategy.name: XAU_RSI_Mean_Reversion_Loose
strategy.rationale: Looser RSI thresholds (<42/>58) with Bollinger band touch confirmation. Session-filtered. Keeps counter-trend logic but requires band extreme to avoid false entries.

history.analysis: PF 0.78, WR 27% with avgW>avgL but too few winners. Stops dominate losses (-$94). Time exits slightly profitable. Spread cost ($17) is ~75% of gross losses. Entries firing into chop or against momentum.
mistakes: Win rate 27% is far too low for the R:R ratio used - need either wider TP or higher-quality entries to reach breakeven WR ~30%
Stops account for -$94 of losses while trails only made +$42 - stop placement at 0.3% is too tight for 5m BTC/XAU noise, triggering on normal wick retracements
Time exits occasionally profitable (+$29) suggesting some trades are correct direction but TP too close or trailing stop too tight to capture the move
Multiple consecutive BTC longs stopped out near same price level (64745, 64775, 64561) - no cooldown respected or market was in clear range/chop, ATR filter too low at 0.08%
changes: Tighten RSI to 32/68 to ensure deeper genuine pullbacks only
Widen stopLossPct to 0.45% to survive normal noise, adjust TP to 1.05% for better R:R
Add sma_cross confirmation to ensure trend is active not just price above static SMA
Increase ATR filter to 0.12% minimum to avoid dead chop periods
Reduce riskPerTradePct to 0.5% to protect capital given current drawdown

strategy.name: XAU_Trend_Pullback_Deep
strategy.rationale: XAU cheapest spread (0.011%). Deep RSI pullbacks in SMA-cross confirmed trends only. Wider stops survive noise. High ATR filter kills chop. Best spread efficiency of all markets.

history.analysis: 27.8% WR with PF 0.68 is deeply unprofitable. Stops account for -$79 loss; trails only +$42. Breakout entries are chasing moves that reverse immediately. XAU longs consistently stop out. Spread at $14.67 on 18 trades is a major drag.
mistakes: Breakout entries on closed candles arrive late - buying the top of the move, not the start. By the time cron fires, breakout is already extended and reversal risk is high.
0.3% stop vs 0.75% TP gives ~2.5R but WR of 28% means expectancy is negative. Need either higher WR setups or tighter entries that improve actual R:R realized.
XAU longs dominate the trade log with 7 of 8 losing. Likely entering during weak pullback continuation attempts in a choppy range rather than genuine trending moments.
Trailing stop of 0.2% on 5m BTC is too tight - profitable BTC trail (63627 entry) exited at breakeven with -$0.02 PnL despite the setup triggering. Trails are being clipped by normal noise.
changes: Switch from breakout-chase to mean-reversion pullback entries: enter after RSI oversold/overbought extremes WITH trend context, so entry is at value not at extension.
Drop ETH entirely - 0.16% round-trip is 8x BTC, makes scalping near-impossible. Focus BTC and XAU only.
Widen trailing stop to 0.35-0.4% to let winners breathe past microstructure noise on 5m candles.
Raise ATR filter threshold to ensure minimum volatility, AND add RSI extreme condition to require both volatility AND overextension before entry.
Increase breakout lookback to 40 bars (200 min) for structural significance on any remaining breakout logic.

strategy.name: RSI_Pullback_Trend_BTC_XAU
strategy.rationale: Buy RSI dips in uptrends, sell RSI pops in downtrends. Entries at value not extension. SMA50 defines trend; RSI30/70 defines pullback. Avoids chasing breakouts that reverse on cron lag.

history.analysis: 7/8 trades lost. Only 1 winner via time-exit. Mean-reversion fighting trend in falling market. XAU longs repeatedly stopped in downtrend. BTC signals contradictory. Spread costs minor vs directional losses.
mistakes: Trading mean-reversion (long oversold) in a persistent downtrend - XAU fell consistently, all 5 XAU longs lost
No trend filter: entering longs when price is below SMA confirms downtrend, not bounce setup
TP 0.9% vs SL 0.45% gives 2:1 but mean-reversion on 5m rarely reaches 0.9% before reversing again - only 1 time-exit won
maxHoldMinutes 60 too short for TP to be reached, yet long enough to accumulate losses - most exits were stop or timeout losers
changes: Add trend filter (price_vs_sma) to only trade in direction of trend - no counter-trend longs in downtrend
Switch to breakout/momentum strategy instead of mean-reversion to align with prevailing momentum
Tighten TP to 0.45% and SL to 0.25% for higher win-rate scalps, or use asymmetric 3:1 with confirmed momentum
Add session filter on XAU to avoid low-liquidity periods and weekend gap risk
Reduce riskPerTradePct to 0.8% given losing streak and capital preservation rules
